scope: Independent review of actual implementations before full gate; each correction has a regression case. These reviews do not replace the full clean-extraction run.

findings.issue: Final sustained note extended when importing into a larger existing pattern
findings.resolution: Preserve in-range final cut and report silent padding

findings.issue: Legal MusicXML attribute spacing lost channel/timing/volume metadata
findings.resolution: Accept whitespace around XML attribute assignment

findings.issue: Dense exported MusicXML falsely failed fractional row-boundary check
findings.resolution: Validate grid tolerance, then integer row bounds

findings.issue: Empty macros bypassed expansion work/label limits
findings.resolution: Bound every expansion visit and emitted macro label bytes

findings.issue: Asynchronous replacement discarded intervening user edits/settings
Global CSS hid new native source pickers
findings.resolution: Scoped visible native picker rule and ancestry coverage

findings.issue: Public checkpoint deletion removed an active experiment rollback state
findings.resolution: Owned checkpoints reject deletion; private release for Restore/Keep

findings.issue: Issuer/source IDs containing colons collided in claim keys
Health endpoint reported ready after poisoned storage
